$comment: Per-shot sha invalidation spec (architecture.md section 9). Change one beat, re-capture one beat. The ledger file is build/captures/invalidation.json inside the project tree; written by video-capturer at capture time (MEASURED tier). Preflight P2 refuses any assembly whose referenced beat ledger is stale.
beat_valid_formula: beat_valid(beat) := beat_sha(beat) == ledger.beat_sha AND fixture_sha == ledger.fixture_sha AND fe_build_sha == ledger.fe_build_sha AND harness_sha == ledger.harness_sha AND lab_stack_sha == ledger.lab_stack_sha
beat_sha_rule: sha256 over the canonical serialization of the beat's subtree of the shot plan's beats[] array: sorted keys, 2-space indent, no timestamps, no generated ids, UTF-8

required_inputs.name: beat_sha
required_inputs.source: canonical serialization of the beat's subtree in the shot plan (beats[] array)

required_inputs.name: fixture_sha
required_inputs.source: sha256 of the fixture payload(s) the beat's state.requires bind

required_inputs.name: fe_build_sha
required_inputs.source: the frontend build the capture ran against

required_inputs.name: lab_stack_sha
required_inputs.source: lab stack version (proxies, auth stub, seeded state)

invalidation_matrix.change: one beat's actions/blocks in the plan

invalidation_matrix.recaptures: nothing — re-render the asset, then compose
nothing — recompute crops + one compose encode
beats on affected routes (conservative default: all beats whose route or asserts touch a changed route; capturer publishes the diff-report)
ALL beats (harness_sha mismatch); 3-launch re-run if film profile

refusal_rule: an editor handed a beat whose ledger is stale refuses in seconds (P2); the lead decides whether to re-capture or re-plan

approval_record.description: Recorded for any threshold change or golden re-mint (approval-worthy events). Thresholds must never be tuned per-run to make a specific cut pass.

generation.description: Golden generation number; re-mint records N+1.

approved_by.description: Actor ENUM — free-form strings are rejected; an agent cannot self-approve.

approval_ref.description: Non-empty AND resolvable to a real artifact: must point at an existing approval record (e.g. .agents/approver/<slug>-tracking.md iteration NNN) whose sha256 is recorded in provenance. Unresolvable ref = FAIL.

guards: a threshold change OR a golden re-mint is APPROVAL-WORTHY — recorded in provenance with reason + approver, never silent
a perceptual FAIL reports MEASURED score vs threshold + the first representative frame that flagged (never bare boolean)
missing golden = BLOCKED-WITH-A-PATH: verifier PROPOSES re-mint with reason class, human APPROVES, re-mint records generation N+1 + approval reference — actionable, never permanently blocked
thresholds must never be tuned per-run to make a specific cut pass

TIER R adaptive sampling: dense around scene boundaries (frame-diff/SSIM-drop) + forced sample points at action windows (pointer travel/press/drag/drop/popup open/row edits) + uniform baseline between them

TIER S semantic spot-check: perceptual != semantic (SSIM/pHash do not understand content); representative frames through the vision channel against per-beat must_include/must_exclude checklist; output is EVIDENCE FOR HUMAN APPROVAL (written verdict per keyframe in the verify report), NOT auto pass/fail; but a miss must be SURFACED LOUDLY, never buried

MASK VALIDATION (exact tier, all three mandatory): (a) every declared critical region inside the exact-compare area — exclusion = FAIL; (b) masked-out area <= mask_area_budget_pct (default 30) — exceedance = FAIL; (c) mask change is APPROVAL-WORTHY (reason_class mask_change) with reason + approver recorded — closes the mask-away-the-hard-parts abuse path

OVERHEAD MEASUREMENT: per-beat, per-tier wall times (Tier E hashing, Tier P metric, Tier R sampling, Tier S vision-call, total verification) recorded in the verify report vs the beat's render wall time; budget <= 15% of render time; on exceedance report plainly + name the dominant cost

APPROVAL IDENTITY: approved_by is an ENUM {user, leader}; free-form strings (e.g. 'video-verifier') are rejected. approval_ref must be non-empty and resolvable to a real artifact (resolution rule above).
DELTA-WITHOUT-RECORD = FAIL: any threshold delta between generations MUST carry a matching approval record; a generation whose thresholds changed with no approval record is a FAIL, not a warning.

MINT-CAPTURE: mask fields (masks[], mask_area_budget_pct, critical_regions, comparison, comparison_thresholds) MUST be frozen in golden provenance at mint time — the mint currently freezes only comparison + thresholds; extend it (C-side mirrors this).

ACTION-LOG SOURCE (M3): the capture harness record is video-lab/prod-v5/capture/inputs.json (sections[] with id + label + startFrame/endFrame; events[] with frame + type). action_windows.source renamed 'capture_action_log' (was 'action_log', which collided with the editor governance log action-log.schema.json). action_type_map (type -> section-id/action-type) makes windows mechanically derivable.
